objective: Frozen computation: for twelve laws on the weave (NAE and signed NAE variants, consistent and not; OR; not-exactly-two; parity; three distance-two orientations), row transfer spectra at widths 3 to 12 (gap, gap x width, states per site), a direct axis correlation on the disordered ones, and a census of whether N, single and pair counts determine each laws bases at n = 4, 5, 6.
title: Transfer gaps of knot laws on the weave
